text: Can you walk me through your background working in automotive quality environments, such as IATF 16949-certified manufacturing plants?
Walk me through a project where you developed or maintained a Control Plan for a new part introduction. What challenges did you run into during implementation?
Explain how Statistical Process Control (SPC) is used to monitor a production line, and how you would interpret an out-of-control signal on a control chart.
If a customer submits a PPAP rejection citing an inconsistent Cpk value on a critical characteristic, how would you investigate the root cause and respond to the customer?
Are you currently certified or trained on IATF 16949 requirements, and would you be available to start supporting our automotive quality team within the next 30 days?
Tell me about your experience working within food safety management systems, such as HACCP-based or GMP-certified facilities.
Walk me through a time you led or supported a HACCP plan review or update. What hazards did you identify, and how did you validate the critical control points?
Explain how allergen control programs work in a shared-line food manufacturing facility, including how cleaning validation is used to prevent cross-contact.
If an internal audit uncovers a recurring temperature deviation at a critical control point that was never escalated, how would you handle the investigation and corrective action?
Do you hold any food safety certifications, such as HACCP, SQF, or BRCGS, and are you comfortable working rotating shifts if the audit schedule requires it?
Can you describe your background working in a GMP-regulated pharmaceutical quality environment?
Walk me through a project where you executed or reviewed a validation protocol, such as an IQ, OQ, or PQ. What issues came up during execution and how did you resolve them?
Explain the purpose of batch record review in pharmaceutical manufacturing and what specific things you look for when reviewing one.
If you discover a deviation during batch record review that was never logged into the CAPA system, how would you proceed?
Are you familiar with 21 CFR Part 211 requirements, and would you be available to join our pharmaceutical quality team on the proposed timeline?
